stem: The first row of a stadium section has 21 seats, and each row after the first has 2 more seats than the row in front of it. The total number of seats in the first \(n\) rows is \(21n + n(n - 1)\). This expression can be written as \((n + a)^{2} - c\), where \(a\) and \(c\) are positive constants. What is the value of \(c\)?
verify:
n, j = symbols('n j', integer=True, positive=True)
e = expand(21*n + n*(n - 1))
assert simplify(summation(21 + 2*(j - 1), (j, 1, n)) - e) == 0
assert expand((n + 10)**2 - 100) == e
assert [Rational(s) for s in spr_answers] == [100]
